title: The cards that read a lane see a GIGA in both of its lanes
notes: Crushing Walls, Occidental, Lane Eater, Midlane Menace, Mid Runner, Celestial Caller, Right-Hand Felinor and Joon Juicer read a GIGA in both of its lanes (R3546001)

player.title: A GIGA counts in both its lanes
fixes: Crushing Walls and Occidental destroy a GIGA that covers lane 1 or lane 5, whichever of its two lanes that is.
Lane Eater destroys a GIGA that covers its lane from the lane beside it, and a GIGA Lane Eater eats both its lanes.
Midlane Menace and Mid Runner count as in midlane when a GIGA covers the middle lane.
Celestial Caller summons its Moon past the far end of a GIGA.
Right-Hand Felinor sees a GIGA to its left, and a GIGA Felinor buffs the Unit beside its first lane.
Joon Juicer buffs the Unit past the far end of a GIGA Joon.
